{{Quote|The target is Uff Wogo. He's of the Marauder species. Grey hair, pony tail, dark brown skin and a heavy drinker. Last seen in the city of Restuss on Rori before it blew up.|Boba Fett|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
'''Uff Wogo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was searching for him on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] due to the high bounty on his head. [[Ogveer]] rescued him and took him to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He was known to be a heavy drinker.
